A '''Tralusian''' was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Notable Tralusians included [[Jonash Solo]], the father of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="The Paradise Snare">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>
